title: Stored XSS in metadata fields
summary:
### Summary
Stored XSS occurs in UI locations where untrusted strings (user input / DB-stored values) are passed through and rendered via [innerHTML].

### Impact
Vulnerability Type
- **Stored XSS**

Impact / Threat Scenarios
- If an attacker can store malicious HTML in tag/document metadata names (e.g., correspondent, document type, etc.), the script can execute for any user who views the affected UI (including administrators).
